choices.reason: Rule 1 retains the two Verbatim-versus-DALL-E-2 analyses because the paper describes Revised as a "secondary, diagnostic condition" that is not central to its "primary treatment contrasts". Rule 2 selects the main-text raw BT specification summarized in the introduction over the Z-score version, explicitly identified as a robustness check in Appendix E.2.
choices.locator: PDF pp. 3–4, section 1 (quoted sentence); p. 9, section 3.1 (DALL-E 3 denotes Verbatim); p. 34, Appendix B.1.1 (Revised arm is secondary); p. 18, section 4.2.1 (raw BT main-text estimate); p. 54, Appendix E.2 (Z-scoring is a robustness check).
choices.quote: Across both tasks, we find that participants assigned to DALL-E 3 produced significantly better outputs than those assigned to DALL-E 2, but that the sources of these gains depend on task structure.
